anchor.section: Metadata: conditional date 1240–1260; genre ‘азбука // склады // частное письмо // подпись к рисунку’; content ‘Грамота мальчика Онфима’

evidence.note: Direct catalogue record: complete instructional text dated 1240–1260, probably the second third of the XIII century, containing alphabet, syllables, drawing inscription and address formula. This is a later-XIII comparator, not direct 1230 evidence; it establishes neither a 1230 school, universal child literacy, a learner in scene, curriculum, skill acquisition, nor a present text.

anchor.section: Metadata: conditional date 1200–1220; content ‘Письмо к посаднику Гюргию Иванковичу — От Матея к Гюргию (о юридических и финансовых делах)’

evidence.note: Direct catalogue record: a private letter to posadnik Gyurgiy Ivankovich about legal and financial matters. It is an early-XIII comparator ending in 1220, not a 1220–1240 constitutional rule; it creates no current office-holder, competence, hierarchy, authority, jurisdiction, procedure, tax, judgment or outcome.

anchor.section: Metadata: conditional date 1160–1180; content identifies Savva’s expedition to Yugra for tribute collection and conflict involving posadnik Zakhariya and Andrey Bogolyubsky’s people

evidence.note: Direct catalogue record: a whole letter dated 1160–1180 with this named expedition/tribute/conflict content. It is an earlier-XII comparator only, not evidence of a 1230 campaign, route, foreign relation, tribute right, troop, authority, location, party knowledge or outcome.

claim_localizations.runtime_text: Грамота Онфима №199 (1240–1260) содержит азбуку, склады, подпись к рисунку и адресную формулу. Это поздний XIII-вековый comparator, не доказательство школы, грамотности или ребёнка в Новгороде 1230 года.

Onfim’s letter 199 (1240–1260) contains an alphabet, syllables, a drawing inscription, and an address formula. It is a later-thirteenth-century comparator, not proof of a school, literacy, or child in Novgorod in 1230.
Ранняя грамота №222 — частное письмо к посаднику Гюргию Иванковичу о юридических и финансовых делах. Это адресный факт, не полномочие, юрисдикция или решение посадника.
Early letter 222 is a private letter to posadnik Gyurgiy Ivankovich about legal and financial matters. This is an address fact, not a posadnik’s competence, jurisdiction, or decision.
Грамота №724 (1160–1180) описывает экспедицию Саввы в Югру за данью и именованный конфликтный контекст. Это XII-вековый comparator, не кампания, маршрут, право на дань или внешняя политика 1230 года.
Letter 724 (1160–1180) describes Savva’s Yugra tribute expedition and a named conflict context. It is a twelfth-century comparator, not a 1230 campaign, route, tribute right, or foreign policy.
